patch_list: Removes the banner, native, full-screen, and video ads from JustWatch and stops the ad networks from starting.
Stops JustWatch's own event tracking, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Meta app events, and Firebase Analytics. Sign-in and your watchlist are left alone. Opt-in; test on-device.

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
Removes JustWatch's own sponsored title cards and sponsored trailers before videos.
